HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   D. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness. .
   C. Say Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles of Dharma 7.1. Virtues of Righteousness.  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Indian Traditional Calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calendar.
   B. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calendar with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Indian Traditional Calendar to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Indian Traditional Calendar has no place in daily life.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

5. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8.? (1 mark)
   A. Say Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8..
   D. Use Virtues of Righteousness. 10 8.0. Utsav 8.1. Social and National festivals 10 8. to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Social and National Festivals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Social and National Festivals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Social and National Festivals.
   C. Say Social and National Festivals has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of integrity? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Aspects of integrity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Aspects of integrity.
   D. Use Aspects of integrity to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Use Social and National festivals 10 8.2. Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The s to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Dainik Prarthana? (1 mark)
   A. Say Dainik Prarthana has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Dainik Prarthana.
   C. Use Dainik Prarthana to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues for righteousness? (1 mark)

   A. Use Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str.
   C. Apply the teaching of Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Indian Traditional Calender 10 NOTE: The suggested number of lessons per sub str has no place in daily life.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Aspects of Integrity. 10 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Pranayam and asanas 10 7.0. Principles o? (1 mark)

   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

15. Which response best shows understanding of Panch- mahabhoot? (1 mark)
   A. Use Panch- mahabhoot to insult classmates of other faiths.
